headline: David Tepper's Latest AI Bet Is CoreWeave
summary: Billionaire investor David Tepper initiated a new CoreWeave stake in Q2 while adding to Nvidia, Amazon and TSMC.

headline: Why Is Netflix Stock Falling on Monday?
summary: Netflix Inc. (NASDAQ: NFLX) stock slips as market concerns over third-quarter revenue and earnings guidance outweigh Bill Ackman's new Pershing Square stake.

headline: Dan Loeb Exits Nvidia, Meta And Broadcom — Bets Big On Warner Bros. Discovery
summary: The investor exited Meta, Nvidia, Broadcom, KLA and Lam Research while adding major positions in Warner Bros. Discovery, Riot Platforms and Block.

headline: Meta Sheds Billions as $1.4 Trillion Trial Opens
summary: Meta stock drops as a federal trial began over its alleged role in causing social media addiction and violating child privacy laws.
